english: The old man told the young warriors' (story?): 'When the god slew the serpent, I was a child. I remember the thunder and the fire. The sky was black and the wind roared. The houses shook and the tree fell. Now the water comes to the streams, seen(?). The rivers flowed(?), and you and the mothers smiled on us. Young men, tell this tale to your children.'

english: The waters stood(?) held in the rock by a wall(?); the hero pursued(?) us. The hero of good fame heard the word of the stream and asked who holds you. 'The hostile serpent holds us in the rock.' He broke it, and went in. The hollow was black within. The being(?) saw him there. He cut its head, and it did not wake. The waters went out, and the word of your fame will be great for us.

english: The serpent lay around the waters. The gods saw him and feared before him. They hid under the bowing sky and in the clouds below(?). Thunder's son? (the yoke of thunder) the god dared. The cursed? one spoke: 'Do not fear. I will kill the serpent.' He found him there and struck him three times with a stone. His spine shook and he died. The gods came down and stood around the corpse. They praise the one who dared.

Two brothers went (dual) against the serpent. One feared, the other dared. Who dared, he struck him with a spear. The beast died, and the waters went out from the rock. The brother ran home, who feared, and spoke to the people: 'My brother killed the beast; bury him.' The old fathers remembered them in song(?). The people buried the brother and gave him a wheel and a yoke.

The gods sat together. One said: 'Who will kill the serpent?' No one spoke; the heart of them trembled with fear. Then Perkwunos stood and said 'I will go.' He yoked his swift horses. The gods chose him and gave him a stone. Father Sky said: 'Son of mine, go and fight(?)'. He went and struck him and (he) died. Then they buried him.

The child asked the grandfather: 'Who killed the serpent?' The old man said: 'Thunder's strong god(?) killed him. He threw a stone at him by day. Why did he throw at him? He turned/held back the water and people thirsted. Its teeth were long and its eyes red stood(?). Now the water flows and we drink.' The child smiled and ran home.
